incident: Daily provider activity was reported green even though social metrics stopped on 2026-10-08, social evaluations stopped on 2026-09-19, and GA4 campaign batches were frequently empty or unmatched.
prevention: store dated source observations with provider authority
distinguish missing, late, empty and observed sources
exclude robot interactions from human performance learning
never treat forecast or suggested action as earned revenue
preserve existing Brein/Powerhouse decision and Heartbeat authorities
